summary: A rewrite line: one struck-out word with an animated pen line, followed by an animated highlighted replacement.
use: Editorial strike-through-and-rewrite effects where the removed text stays announced as deleted and the animation respects reduced motion.
spec: `<StrikeThrough animated>workarounds</StrikeThrough>` draws the line on mount
`<Highlight animated>one-shot components</Highlight>` follows as the replacement
